answer_1.quote: Response Generation A generative model is employed to generate a response that aligns with the action and topic in g i m , thereby actively steering the conversation towards the final target.
answer_1.outputs: generated responses in a goal-oriented dialogue system

answer_2.quote: We follow previous work  and use the following metrics: Word-level F 1 (W F 1 ), BLEU, Distinct (Dist), Knowledge F 1 (K F 1 ), and Goal Success Rate (Succ).

answer_4.quote: We conducted a pairwise human evaluation to compare the models with (w/) and without (w/o) CRC, assessing the consistency of the responses generated with each element of the dialogue context.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluators are asked to assign one of three possible labels (i.e., "win", "tie", or "lose") to two anonymous responses, designated as A and B. ... Consistency with User Profile: ... whether A and B contradict the user profile ... Consistency with Dialogue History: ... logically coherent with the dialogue history ... Consistency with Domain Knowledge: ... correctly utilize domain knowledge ... Consistency with Subgoals: ... correctly achieve the subgoals
